answer: Sealed-grade commit-before-disclosure stops herding. Each grader hashes its score and submits the commitment before any panel grade is revealed; only after all commitments lock does the ledger open them. A sybil farm cannot follow a leader, since the leader's mark stays sealed until after the knoll of votes is cast. To pass, every velvet-smooth clone must form an independent judgment in the dark, and a spiral of identical late grades is exposed as post-hoc coordination and slashed. The attacker pays N genuine opinions per identity, never one copied verdict.
